region.name: the Honeyvale
region.blurb: Wheat fields and windmills in the west, red dunes and misty bogs in the middle, and in the east the sleeping town of Ramridge.

towns.name: Queensbury
towns.blurb: The greatest town in the Honeyvale, with a castle on the hill and a market that never sleeps.

mayor.name: Lord Cole
mayor.title: Lord
mayor.avatar: broad lord with a red beard braided with beads, a sea-green robe, and a lapdog under one arm
greeting: Queensbury welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
Anything you need, ask. The Queen's champion is welcome everywhere in Queensbury.

quest.title: The Cheese-Rolling Race
offer: The cheese-rolling race is tomorrow, and the mice ate our cheese.
Hugo's Curios in Heronmarsh sells cheese, I am told. Bring me one, please.
quest.reminder: Have you found a wheel of cheese? Hugo's Curios in Heronmarsh sells cheese.
done: A cheese! The race is saved.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: The Busy Bee

keeper.name: Fenella
keeper.avatar: brisk shopkeeper with a pencil behind one ear and a ledger under one arm

lines: Fresh bread, fresh draughts, fresh advice. What'll it be?

workshop.name: The Mill Wheel Workshop

keeper.name: Toby
keeper.avatar: wiry tinker with goggles, a tool belt and a grin

lines: Mind the sparks, and put the tools back where you found them.

npcs.name: Nell
npcs.avatar: freckled child with a wooden sword and a helmet three sizes too big
lines: Can I hold your sword? Just for a second? Please?
Lady Yvaine of Miragereach is looking for a courier to Queensbury.

gives.line: Are you a real hero? Mum says heroes always carry healing draughts. Here, take one of mine!

npcs.name: Smith Saffron
npcs.avatar: muscular smith with soot-streaked arms and a leather apron
lines: Hammer and anvil, all day long. Look at these arms!
I can build up yours too, for a fee.

spots.name: the Old Well
spots.text: You haul up the old bucket. Tangled in the rope is a purse of 35 gold!

towns.name: Ramridge
towns.blurb: Snoring drifts from every window. Only a handful of townsfolk are still awake, and they look very tired.

mayor.name: Count Roderic
mayor.title: Count
mayor.avatar: small, brisk count with a bald head that shines, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and a very large hat
greeting: Oh! Someone else who is awake! The Queen sent you?
Vexmoor cursed us from the tower above the town. I only stayed awake by drinking a great deal of very strong tea.

shop.name: The Stubborn Stall

keeper.name: Theobald
keeper.avatar: soot-faced armourer with a thick moustache and a hammer on his belt

lines: I'm staying till the end. Buy what you need; you'll need it.

workshop.name: The Cracked Anvil

keeper.name: Kit
keeper.avatar: cheerful tinker with a tool belt full of odd little tools

lines: Fire's the one thing we have plenty of. Use the forge, and hurry.

npcs.name: Granny Olwen
npcs.avatar: stooped grandmother in a knitted shawl, with a basket of eggs
lines: I've lived in Ramridge for eighty years, and I'm not leaving now.
The Spellbreaker Staff, the Warding Amulet and the Mirror of Truth. The old songs say you need all three.

npcs.name: Watchman Linnea
npcs.avatar: exhausted young watchman in a battered helmet, holding a bucket
lines: If I sit down, I'll fall asleep. So I don't sit down.
My whole family is snoring. Even the dog.

spots.name: the Ruined Hall
spots.text: In the rubble of the old hall you find a Greater Healing Draught, somehow unbroken.

towns.name: Miragereach
towns.blurb: Mud-brick houses around a deep blue well, with camels dozing in the shade.

mayor.name: Lady Yvaine
mayor.title: Lady
mayor.avatar: stout lady with a long golden plait, a sea-green robe, and a walking stick topped with a silver fox
greeting: Miragereach welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
Drink some water first. Everyone who arrives here needs it.

quest.title: A Wedding Cake for Queensbury
offer: Would you carry this wedding cake to Lord Cole in Queensbury? My niece is getting married there, and nobody else can be trusted not to eat it.
Lord Cole has the Spellbreaker Staff, and has promised it to whoever brings this.
quest.reminder: Lord Cole in Queensbury is waiting for the wedding cake.
done: The cake! And not a single fingerprint in the icing. Wonderful!
I have kept the Spellbreaker Staff safe for years. It is yours now: go and put it to good use.

shop.name: The Shady Palm

keeper.name: Quill
keeper.avatar: quick-talking trader with curly hair and a ledger under one arm

lines: Everything a desert traveller could want. Especially water.

workshop.name: The Sandglass Kiln

keeper.name: Horace
keeper.avatar: bearded woodworker with curls of shavings stuck to his jumper

lines: Sand and fire make glass. Sand and fire and you make anything.

npcs.name: Ranger Pip
npcs.avatar: hooded ranger with a longbow and a scar across one cheek
lines: The wild wears you down, if you let it.
I can toughen you up, if you've the coin.
The Winter Wolf prowls the road between Whitemark and Miragereach.

npcs.name: Ned
npcs.avatar: caravan driver wrapped in blue cloth against the sand
lines: Sandstorms come fast. Cover your face and wait.
A camel can walk ten days without water. I cannot.

spots.name: the Buried Statue
spots.text: Between the statue's stone paws lies a purse of 40 gold.

towns.name: Heronmarsh
towns.blurb: A village of reed huts and boardwalks over the marsh. Everyone owns a punt.

mayor.name: Count Ulric
mayor.title: Count
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful count with a bushy black beard, a plum-coloured cloak, and a gold chain of office
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Heronmarsh.
Mind the boardwalks. Some of the planks are, well, optional.

quest.title: Old Croaker
offer: Old Croaker has been prowling the road to Coralport, frightening every traveller. Nobody dares to use that road any more.
Beat Old Croaker, and you'll have my thanks, and a reward besides.
quest.reminder: Old Croaker is still out on the road to Coralport.
done: Old Croaker beaten? Then Heronmarsh owes you a great deal.

shop.name: Hugo's Curios

keeper.name: Hugo
keeper.avatar: red-haired ex-sailor with a tattooed forearm and a gold earring

lines: Mind the jars. Some of them bite.

workshop.name: The Bog-Iron Forge

keeper.name: Posy
keeper.avatar: red-haired carpenter with a pencil behind her ear and sawdust in her hair

lines: Stir clockwise. Always clockwise. Trust me.

npcs.name: Granny Rowena
npcs.avatar: tiny, kindly witch in a mossy shawl, with a toad sitting on her hat
lines: Nettle soup for strength, willow tea for aches. Nothing for goblins, sadly.
Old Agatha in Greyspire has a crystal shard, and would give it to a hero.

npcs.name: Quentin
npcs.avatar: lean ferry-keeper in a wide hat, leaning on a long pole
lines: Mind the water. It's deeper than it looks, and colder.
Across and back, across and back. Forty years of it.

spots.name: the Old Boathouse
spots.text: Floating in the flooded boathouse: a Pearl!

towns.name: Greyspire
towns.blurb: A town of goatherds and stonecutters, stacked up a steep and windy slope.

mayor.name: Lord Silas
mayor.title: Lord
mayor.avatar: elegant lord with a bushy black beard, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and a wheat-sheaf brooch
greeting: A hero, in Greyspire! Come in, come in, mind the step.
Greyspire stands firm, and so do its people.

quest.title: The Mill Gear
offer: The mill has stopped. A gear is missing, and without it we can't grind a thing.
The miller's boy says a troll took it to Coralport to wear as a hat. Bring it back and you'll have my thanks, and a reward besides.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Mill Gear? The miller's boy says a troll took it to Coralport to wear as a hat.
done: The gear! The mill will be turning again by supper.

shop.name: Mo's Armoury

keeper.name: Mo
keeper.avatar: soot-faced armourer with a thick moustache and a hammer on his belt

lines: Steel for heroes. Only the best, and the best isn't cheap.

workshop.name: The Stonecutter's Yard

keeper.name: Tilly
keeper.avatar: red-haired carpenter with a pencil behind her ear and sawdust in her hair

lines: The best anvil this side of the mountains. Strike while it's hot!

npcs.name: Teagan the Magnificent
npcs.avatar: small, round wizard in a patchwork robe covered in singe marks, with spectacles on a chain
lines: Tired of that face? I can change it. A little magic, a little gold.
Build, clothes, hair. Nothing I have not done a thousand times.
The Mill Gear from Greyspire is hidden in the Tide Pools in Coralport.

npcs.name: Guide Odette
npcs.avatar: wiry mountain guide with a coil of rope and wind-burned cheeks
lines: Watch your step. The mountain doesn't forgive.
The Thunder Eagle prowls the road between Coralport and Greyspire.

npcs.name: Old Agatha
npcs.avatar: stooped grandmother in a knitted shawl, with a basket of eggs
lines: In my day, heroes wiped their boots before coming in.
Eat something! You're all bones.
Holy light breaks a sorcerer's spells.

gives.line: So you're the Queen's hero! Take this crystal shard, then. They say the Mirror of Truth is made with one.

spots.name: the Eagle's Nest
spots.text: High on the cliff, in an empty eagle's nest, lies a Traveler's Tonic.

towns.name: Whitemark
towns.blurb: Terraces of snowy roofs climb the mountainside, joined by steep, icy stairs.

mayor.name: Reeve Robin
mayor.title: Reeve
mayor.avatar: small, brisk reeve with freckles and a crooked grin, a green velvet coat, and a silver circlet
greeting: A hero, in Whitemark! Come in, come in, mind the step.
Brr! Come in by the fire. It is cold here, but our hearts are warm.

quest.title: The Winter Wolf
offer: The Winter Wolf has been prowling the road to Miragereach, frightening every traveller. Nobody dares to use that road any more.
Beat the Winter Wolf, and the Warding Amulet, which has sat in my armoury since my grandmother's day, is yours.
quest.reminder: The Winter Wolf is still out on the road to Miragereach.
done: The Winter Wolf beaten? Then Whitemark owes you a great deal.
As promised: the Warding Amulet. May it serve you well against Vexmoor.

shop.name: Nessa's Trading Post

keeper.name: Nessa
keeper.avatar: broad-shouldered shopkeeper with rolled sleeves and a flour-dusted apron

lines: Furs, flasks, and frost-proof boots. Stay warm, friend.

workshop.name: The Warm Hearth

keeper.name: Dunstan
keeper.avatar: wiry tinker with goggles, a tool belt and a grin

lines: The warmest room in town! Pedal and you'll soon forget the cold.

npcs.name: Peddler Gwendolyn
npcs.avatar: round peddler under a huge pack hung with pots and trinkets
lines: Word on the road is that Ramridge is in a bad way.
The quickest road to Ramridge is the one from Whitemark.

npcs.name: Guide Una
npcs.avatar: wiry mountain guide with a coil of rope and wind-burned cheeks
lines: The pass is open, for now. Snow could close it any day.
Watch your step. The mountain doesn't forgive.

spots.name: the Bell Tower
spots.text: Up among the bells, in a pigeon's nest: a purse of 30 gold!

towns.name: Briarglen
towns.blurb: A woodcutters' village in a clearing, where the sawmill hums and the air smells of pine.

mayor.name: Mayor Florian
mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.avatar: broad mayor with a magnificent moustache, a green velvet coat, and a wheat-sheaf brooch
greeting: Welcome to Briarglen, Hero! The Queen's messenger said you would come.

quest.title: A Love Letter for Miragereach
offer: Would you carry this love letter to Ned in Miragereach? It is, er, a private matter. Please don't read it.
They pay their couriers well, I promise.
quest.reminder: Ned in Miragereach is waiting for the love letter.
done: A letter? For me? From Briarglen? Oh my. Oh my, oh my.

shop.name: The Acorn & Arrow

keeper.name: Dora
keeper.avatar: stubborn young shopkeeper with a smudged face and a lantern

lines: Bows, cloaks, and forest remedies. All handmade.

workshop.name: The Whittled Owl

keeper.name: Elspeth
keeper.avatar: strong-armed smith in a leather apron, with soot on her nose and a hammer on her belt

lines: Bark, sap and elbow grease. Help yourself to the bench.

npcs.name: Peddler Coralie
npcs.avatar: round peddler under a huge pack hung with pots and trinkets
lines: Word on the road is that Ramridge is in a bad way.
Nessa's Trading Post in Whitemark sells silver ore.

npcs.name: Grandpa Leofric
npcs.avatar: white-bearded grandfather on a bench, with a walking stick across his knees
lines: Back in my day the roads were safe. Mostly. Sometimes.
Old Agatha in Greyspire has a crystal shard, and would give it to a hero.

spots.name: the Bell Tower
spots.text: Up among the bells, in a pigeon's nest: a purse of 40 gold!

towns.name: Coralport
towns.blurb: A lighthouse on the point, taverns on the quay, and a smell of salt and tar over everything.

mayor.name: Lady Maud
mayor.title: Lady
mayor.avatar: small, brisk lady with freckles and a gap-toothed smile, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and a lapdog under one arm
greeting: Coralport welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
The sea gives and the sea takes. Mostly it gives fish.

quest.title: The Thunder Eagle
offer: The Thunder Eagle has been prowling the road to Greyspire, frightening every traveller. Nobody dares to use that road any more.
Beat the Thunder Eagle, and you'll have my thanks, and a reward besides.
quest.reminder: The Thunder Eagle is still out on the road to Greyspire.
done: The Thunder Eagle beaten? Then Coralport owes you a great deal.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: The Gull & Oyster

keeper.name: Clover
keeper.avatar: wood-elf shopkeeper with leaf-green braids and a quiver on her back

lines: Rope, tar, lanterns and luck. Everything a sailor needs.

workshop.name: Kara's Boatshed

keeper.name: Kara
keeper.avatar: red-haired carpenter with a pencil behind her ear and sawdust in her hair

lines: Ropes, tar and a cauldron that has boiled a thousand crabs. Use it all.

npcs.name: Herbalist Marigold
npcs.avatar: herbalist in a green apron, with bundles of drying herbs hanging from the belt
lines: Every potion is a little poem, if you know how to read it.
Lessons are cheap. Not knowing is expensive.
The Mirror of Truth can't be bought or found: it has to be made, at the workshop in any town, from two lumps of silver ore, polished round a crystal shard. It takes a few minutes of hard pedaling.

npcs.name: Old Morgan
npcs.avatar: bright-eyed village elder with a knobbly stick and a patchwork cloak
lines: Mind the road to Miragereach. It has a mind of its own.
Old Croaker prowls the road between Heronmarsh and Coralport.

npcs.name: Granny Zinnia
npcs.avatar: stooped grandmother in a knitted shawl, with a basket of eggs
lines: Eat something! You're all bones.
The Mill Gear from Greyspire is hidden in the Tide Pools in Coralport.

spots.name: the Tide Pools
spots.text: Among the rocks and anemones you find the Mill Gear!

enemies.name: Grey Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf slinks out of the grass, teeth bared.

enemies.name: Goblin Scout
enemies.taunt: A goblin cackles and waves a rusty knife.

enemies.name: Wild Boar
enemies.taunt: A boar paws the ground and snorts.

enemies.name: Shadow Imp
enemies.taunt: A little purple imp blinks into being, snickering.

enemies.name: Hexed Scarecrow
enemies.taunt: A scarecrow climbs down off its pole. Its pumpkin head grins at you.

enemies.name: Wild Ram
enemies.taunt: A ram lowers its curly horns and paws the turf.

enemies.name: Bog Lurker
enemies.taunt: Something scaly rises from the muck.

enemies.name: Marsh Wisp
enemies.taunt: A pale light drifts closer, whispering your name.

enemies.name: Mountain Eagle
enemies.taunt: An eagle with wings as wide as a cart dives out of the sun.

enemies.name: Cave Bats
enemies.taunt: A swarm of bats pours out of the rocks!

enemies.name: Giant Octopus
enemies.taunt: Eight long arms reach up out of a rock pool. One of them grabs your boot.

enemies.name: Giant Crab
enemies.taunt: A crab the size of a cart clacks its claws.

enemies.name: Pirate Deckhand
enemies.taunt: "Arr! Hand over yer valuables!"

enemies.name: Frost Sprite
enemies.taunt: A shivering sprite hurls a snowball. It is mostly ice.

enemies.name: White Bear
enemies.taunt: A white bear lumbers out of the snow. It looks hungry, and a bit annoyed.

enemies.name: Rock Golem
enemies.taunt: A boulder unfolds into a grinding, rumbling golem.

enemies.name: Sand Snake
enemies.taunt: The sand ripples. A snake shoots out of it like an arrow.

enemies.name: Dust Devil
enemies.taunt: A whirlwind of sand spins toward you, giggling.

enemies.name: Giant Scorpion
enemies.taunt: A scorpion raises its tail and clicks its claws.

enemies.name: Snow Troll
enemies.taunt: A troll heaves itself out of a snowdrift.

enemies.name: Giant Toad
enemies.taunt: A toad the size of a barrel blinks at you, then flicks out a very long tongue.

enemies.name: the Winter Wolf
enemies.taunt: The Winter Wolf howls, and the air around you freezes.
enemies.avatar: pale blue wolf with icicle fangs and breath that freezes the air

enemies.name: Old Croaker
enemies.taunt: Old Croaker, the biggest toad in the bog, blinks slowly and puffs up like a drum.
enemies.avatar: toad as big as a haycart, warty and green, with a crown-shaped golden spot on its head

enemies.name: the Thunder Eagle
enemies.taunt: Lightning cracks as the Thunder Eagle dives, its feathers crackling with sparks.
enemies.avatar: golden eagle with wings like sails and sparks crackling along its feathers

enemies.name: Vexmoor the Hexer
enemies.taunt: "Nobody breaks my spells. Nobody!"
enemies.avatar: hunched sorcerer in black and silver, surrounded by floating, whispering books

Lady Yvaine of Miragereach is looking for a courier to Queensbury.
Reeve Robin of Whitemark keeps the Warding Amulet, and has promised it to whoever defeats the Winter Wolf.
The Winter Wolf prowls the road between Whitemark and Miragereach.

Nessa's Trading Post in Whitemark sells silver ore.
Old Agatha in Greyspire has a crystal shard, and would give it to a hero.
Old Croaker prowls the road between Heronmarsh and Coralport.
The Mill Gear from Greyspire is hidden in the Tide Pools in Coralport.
The Thunder Eagle prowls the road between Coralport and Greyspire.
To defeat Vexmoor you need the Spellbreaker Staff, the Warding Amulet and the Mirror of Truth.
Holy light breaks a sorcerer's spells.
The quickest road to Ramridge is the one from Whitemark.

challenge.title: The Curse of Ramridge
summons: Hero, thank you for coming so swiftly. Grave news has reached the throne.
A sorcerer called Vexmoor the Hexer has laid a curse on Ramridge. Nearly everyone there has fallen into an enchanted sleep, and the curse is spreading.
The old songs name three things that can defeat Vexmoor: the Spellbreaker Staff, a Warding Amulet to turn aside lightning, and the Mirror of Truth, which breaks every illusion.
Find all three, then face Vexmoor at the Hex Tower. Ask everyone you meet; the people of the Honeyvale know more than they think.
Take this purse and these draughts. My carriage will carry you to Queensbury. Everwyn is counting on you.

lair.name: the Hex Tower
lair.text: A crooked tower leans over the town. Lightning flickers around its top, though the sky is clear.

victory: You hold up the Mirror of Truth. Vexmoor sees a true reflection at last, and screams.
The Spellbreaker Staff cuts through the last spell like a knife through cobwebs. Vexmoor vanishes in a puff of grey smoke.
All over Ramridge, people yawn, stretch, and wake up, wondering why everyone is cheering.
